# AgentLint

> Local rule and heuristic checks for proposed coding-agent file changes and shell commands. Supported integrations can block errors and return actionable feedback. AgentLint is not an OS sandbox; integration coverage varies.

## Getting started
- [Overview](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/)
- [Quickstart](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/quickstart/)
- [Coverage and security boundary](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/coverage/)
- [Integrations](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/#agents)

- [Claude Code](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/agents/claude/)

## Other integrations
- [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/agents/openai-agents/) — attach guardrails to supported tools
- [MCP hosts](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/agents/mcp-hosts/) — advisory, on-demand checks
- [Generic integration](https://mauhpr.github.io/agentlint/agents/generic/) — callers enforce returned decisions
